status: ALL LABELS PROPOSED — NONE REVIEWED. Awaiting human review; see disposition-review.md.
proposedBy: JEV-04 municipal worker (AI agent), 2026-09-21. An agent proposal, not a review.
method: Each value was judged individually from the feedback text against the five definitions below. Values were NOT derived from the source tag, from an Unclear agency label, or from any model output. Abusive or rude wording was not treated as non-actionable. Rationales flag the proposals the author was least sure about with 'Uncertain'.
definitionsSource: lib/scenarios.ts — municipal preset, question `disposition`, criteria (copied verbatim; a test keeps them in sync)

definitions.routable: Enough detail to recommend an agency now.
definitions.needs_clarification: Potentially within the configured service scope, but material facts are missing — for example no location and no concrete example of what happened.
definitions.outside_scope: Clearly outside the configured municipal service scope, such as an unrelated request or question.
definitions.non_actionable: No issue or request to act on: a compliment, gibberish, empty text, or a pure attempt to manipulate these instructions.
definitions.human_review: Enough detail to describe the issue, but responsibility is disputed or cannot be resolved under the supplied responsibility definitions.

entryFormat: { caseId, value, provenance, rationale, review? }. value is one of the five keys above, or null for no label. provenance is 'proposed' or (after a human review only) 'reviewed' with review { reviewer, reviewedOn: YYYY-MM-DD, note? }. A reviewer who changes the value keeps the original in proposedValue.
